title: Cohomology on a sheaf of sets computed on the localized topos
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the inverse image along the localization morphism j : Sh(C/K) -> Sh(C) preserves injective abelian sheaves and that the cohomology of an abelian sheaf on C over the sheaf of sets K equals its cohomology on the localized topos (statement lines 2096-2105). The proof proves preservation of injectives through the adjunction (proof lines 2107-2110) and then computes the cohomology by restricting an injective resolution along j^{-1} (proof lines 2110-2114). The non-formal content is the adjunction argument for injectives. The claim is H2: one adjunction argument plus one computation.
